apt_file_main_config.description: Path to the main apt-file configuration file, relative to Dir::Etc.

apt_file_index_names.description: Comma-separated list of index name types to search by default (e.g., 'deb', 'udeb', 'source').

apt_file_parser_check_description_header.description: Whether to expect and validate a description header in Contents files (set to 'true' for older dak/reprepro output).
